greet.竞技场管理人莉莉: Bence vahşi doğadaki düşmanları yenmek pek bir şey değil. Asıl güçlüler insanlar arasındaki yarışmada kazananlardır.
greet.技能训练师（人类）: Bu dünyada yaşamak için savaşmanın dışında bir zanaat da öğrenmelisin.
greet.小草堆: Otların arasında sıradan bir enfiye kutusu var gibi.
greet.魔法土堆: Gevşek bir toprak yığını, biraz tuhaf görünüyor.
greet.林隐仙子: Ormanda bolca doğa büyüsü var; sessizce dinlenerek ona karışabilirim.
greet.闪光的草堆: Otların arasında tuhaf bitki tohumları var gibi.
greet.警卫卡鲁: Ne zaman bu lanet yerden gidebileceğim...
greet.荒野向导: Seni gördüğüme sevindim genç. Başımda ? işareti varsa bir görevi bende tamamlayabilirsin demektir, bunu unutma.
greet.神殿传送员: Merhaba genç maceracı. Acemi eğitimin bitince seni Kâhin Tapınağı'na ışınlayacağım; orada gerçek zorluklar seni bekliyor.
greet.狄亚·先知之手: Tapınağı güçlü bir kötülük kuşatmış; burada nöbet tuttuğum için ayrılamıyorum, kâhin için türlü işleri sizin yapmanız gerekiyor.
greet.神谕先知: Herkesin kendi yolu vardır... dünyanın da kendi yolu. Karanlık vadilerden geçsek bile korkmamıza gerek yok, çünkü dünya bizimle yürür.
greet.神殿侍卫: Eskiden burada hiç vahşi hayvan saldırısı olmazdı, ama artık her gün türlü canavarın tacizleriyle uğraşıyoruz.
greet.神殿大厨: Bugünün ana yemeği kuru yaprakta kızarmış körpe kabuk böceği, yarın da... iyi bir aşçı yarını düşünmemeli.
greet.追迹者: Bir iz sürücü olarak öğrendiğim ilk şey iz sürmek değil, gizlenmekti.
greet.夜精灵男孤儿: Büyüyünce her ırktan yüz güzelden oluşan bir harem kuracağım! Kutsal bir canavarla dünyayı fethedeceğim!
greet.夜精灵女孤儿: Ben de senin gibi maceraya çıkmak istiyorum, ama öğretmen önce çok çalışmamı istiyor.
greet.神殿教师: Bu yolunu kaybetmiş çocukları elimden geldiğince eğitiyorum; ırkımızın ruhunu taşıyacak tohumlar olsunlar.
greet.会计师工会志愿者: Kehanet Kâhini hakkında ne düşünürsen düşün, bildiğim tek şey hesaplarının darmadağın olduğu... Tapınaktan ödül alacaksan bana gelmelisin, ben hesabı yanlış yapmam...
greet.种植者工会志愿者: Durmadan öldürüp biçmek uzun soluklu bir yol değil. Buraya ovanın yaşamını sürdürecek dayanıklı bitkiler ekmeye geldim.
greet.通灵学徒: Kâhin derin düşünceye daldığında tehlikeli ruhlar denizine iner; bizim görevimiz onu korumak.
greet.道具商人（夜精灵）: Maceraya çıkan herkesin ihtiyacı olan ıvır zıvırı satarım. Büyük kahramanlar bile şişelerim ve küçük aletlerim olmadan yapamaz!
greet.武器商人（夜精灵）: Her türlü silah satılır ve onarılır! Kahramanların ekmek teknesi! Paraya kıymayın! Erkek kadın bütün kahramanlar buyursun!
greet.防具商人（夜精灵）: Her türlü zırh satılır ve onarılır! Kahramanların ekmek teknesi! Paraya kıymayın!
greet.饰品商人（夜精灵）: Her türlü takı satılır ve onarılır! Kahramanların ekmek teknesi!
greet.驯兽师（夜精灵）: Sana sadık bir büyülü canavar! Hiç yorulmayan bir koruyucu! Asla ihanet etmeyen bir yoldaş! ...Yeter ki yemini benden alıp onu iyi besle.
greet.宝石加工者（夜精灵）: Mücevherler! Ah, dünyanın en güzel ve en değerli şeyleri. Özellikle ekipmana takılabilenler, özel bir arıtma işlemiyle yapılır.
greet.采矿人（夜精灵）: Madencilik ne büyük iş! Bütün ömrümü damar aramaya verdim, çünkü hep inanılmaz kazanç getiriyor.
greet.考古理论者（夜精灵）: Bu kıtada neler yaşandı? Dedikoduya inanma; gerçeği ancak eski kalıntılar anlatır.
greet.技能训练师（夜精灵）: Bu dünyada yaşamak için savaşmanın dışında bir zanaat da öğrenmelisin.
greet.盲眼向导（夜精灵）: Yalnızca 100 altına arabalarımla şehirler arasında hızla gidip gelebilirsin. Uzun yolların sıkıntısını çekmezsin.
greet.希尔芙传信使（夜精灵）: Pulun varsa arkadaşlarına mektup ve paket gönderebilirsin.

greet.点点我: Hello, young adventurer. You can choose what to talk about below our conversation. See the ! above my head? It means I have a quest for you. Start with your first main quest: [Sign Up].
greet.新兵队长: Glad to see you, youngster. If I have a ? above my head, you can complete a quest with me. Remember that.
greet.新兵教练: I review the battle results here.
greet.教练员: Items you win in battle go straight into your bag.
greet.初级战斗导师: To face the challenges of your future adventures you must learn how to attack. Tap the monster you want to attack; your character will walk to the target and keep attacking.
greet.观林镇传送员: Hello, young adventurer. When your recruit training is finished I will teleport you to a new town, where real challenges await.
greet.驿站老板（人类）: For only 100 gold my coaches will carry you quickly between cities. No more long, tiring roads.
greet.道具商人（人类）: I sell all the odds and ends every adventurer needs. Even great heroes cannot do without my bottles and little tools!
greet.魔法储物箱: This chest is enchanted. It holds a lot, and you can take your things back out in any city.
greet.武器商人（人类）: Weapons of every kind, sold and repaired! The tools of a hero's trade! Don't be stingy! Heroes one and all, step right up!
greet.防具商人（人类）: Armor of every kind, sold and repaired! The tools of a hero's trade! Don't be stingy!
greet.驯兽师（人类）: A magic beast loyal to you! A guardian that never tires! A companion that never betrays! ...As long as you buy its feed from me and feed it well.
greet.饰品商人（人类）: Accessories of every kind, sold and repaired! The tools of a hero's trade!
greet.宝石匠（人类）: Gems! Ah, the most beautiful and precious things in the world. Especially those that can be set into equipment, made by a special refining process.
greet.契约欢乐使者: I come from a distant world, carrying the hopes and wishes of many people. On holidays I hand out all kinds of gifts. Have fun!
greet.神秘商人: There are powerful treasures in this world that will make things easier for you. Take a look at the shop.
greet.观林镇镇长: Welcome, young adventurer. The town has had plenty of trouble lately, and we badly need your help.
greet.护林游侠: Watch your step, human. Harm the forest and you will answer to me. But most of the time it is you who should take care that the forest does not harm you.
greet.民兵队长: Thank you for coming to help. But first keep yourself in hand and follow orders; only then will you be of use.
greet.馋鬼: You there, have you found anything new and tasty?
greet.寡妇安娜: My husband is dead, my husband is dead, my husband is dead... If I had not wanted mushrooms he would not have taken me picking, and those spiders would not have bitten him... It is all my fault...
greet.走私者: Go... move along, you have no business here.
greet.疯子: They are coming! They torture me! They say the world will end! It is all true! Everyone will die! Blood! Aaah!
greet.疯子的老婆: Ah... ever since my husband was attacked by a gang in the forest, he has lost his mind.
greet.护民官: When you help the people of the kingdom they may give you a People's Medal. The King rewards those who carry these medals; bring them to me.
greet.汤姆: Heroes who rescue princesses are so boring! When I grow up I will be a wild dark hero! And then... then... I will have every dentist executed!
greet.人类信箱: If you have a stamp you can send letters and parcels to your friends.
greet.杰西: They say the noble ladies in the capital eat cream cake every day... how lovely.
greet.炼金师: Alchemy is a noble art that joins magic and medicine. A lifetime is not enough to learn its secrets... So the best thing is to use it to make money!
greet.育种园丁: The flowers are about to wither; I am gathering the seeds worth saving and preparing for the future.
greet.杰克医生: I treat the illnesses of people and animals alike, but I wish people would learn to prevent disease.
greet.人类居民: The lumber camp keeps getting attacked; we cannot get any work done.
greet.采矿人（人类）: What a great trade mining is! I have spent my whole life searching for veins, because the profit is always incredible.
greet.装备强化大师: As the Blacksmiths' Guild representative here, I offer equipment enhancement.
greet.魔法兽强化大师: I represent the Beast Tamers' Guild; I offer enhancement services for magic beasts.
greet.医生工会学徒: Greetings, fearless adventurer! I am Fige, apprentice of the Doctors' Guild. For 100 gold I will restore your HP and mana on the spot!
greet.沧桑的旅者: I have traveled far in my life and set foot in nearly every corner of this continent. I am old now, but I am happy to help you with my experience.
greet.考古理论者（人类）: What happened on this continent? Do not believe gossip; only the old ruins tell the truth.
greet.竞技场管理人莉莉: To my mind, beating enemies in the wild is nothing much. The truly strong are those who win in contests between people.
greet.源质炼金师（人类）: The alchemy of decomposition is a deep art.
greet.技能训练师（人类）: To live in this world you should learn a craft besides fighting.
greet.小草堆: There seems to be an ordinary snuff box in the grass.
greet.魔法土堆: A loose mound of dirt; it looks a little strange.
greet.野菜: Fresh ferns growing in the forest.
greet.魔法草: A special plant that grows in the forest.
greet.林隐仙子: The forest is full of nature magic; by resting quietly I can become part of it.
greet.闪光的草堆: There seem to be strange plant seeds in the grass.
greet.警卫卡鲁: When will I ever get out of this cursed place...
greet.战士守卫: It is not safe here. Be careful.
greet.荒野向导: Glad to see you, youngster. If I have a ? above my head, you can complete a quest with me. Remember that.
greet.训练官: I review the battle results here.
greet.神殿传送员: Hello, young adventurer. When your recruit training is finished I will teleport you to the Prophet's Temple, where real challenges await.
greet.狄亚·先知之手: A powerful evil surrounds this temple. I keep watch here and cannot leave, so I need people like you to do all kinds of things for the Prophet.
greet.神谕先知: Everyone has their own path... and the world has its own. Even when we walk through the darkest valley we need not fear, for the world walks with us.
greet.神殿侍卫: Wild beasts never used to attack here, but now we deal with all kinds of monsters every day.
greet.神殿大厨: Today's main dish is tender bark bugs roasted in dry leaves, and tomorrow... a good cook should not think about tomorrow.
greet.追迹者: As a tracker, the first thing I learned was not how to track, but how to hide.
greet.夜精灵男孤儿: When I grow up I will have a harem of a hundred beauties of every race! And conquer the world with a sacred beast!
greet.夜精灵女孤儿: I want to go adventuring like you too, but the teacher wants me to study more first.
greet.神殿教师: I teach these lost children as best I can, so they become seeds that carry the spirit of our people.
greet.会计师工会志愿者: Whatever you think of the Oracle Prophet, all I know is her books are a mess... If you want rewards from the temple, come to me; I never get the sums wrong...
greet.种植者工会志愿者: Endless killing and reaping is no lasting way. I came here to plant hardy plants that keep the plain alive.
greet.通灵学徒: When the Prophet meditates she dives into the dangerous sea of spirits; our duty is to guard her.
